body.description: Final source review found my finite stdio recovery authenticated the retained terminal signature and checked original rollout, execution epoch, daemon and stream digests, but did not compare terminal.container_id against the original signed creation/cleanup lifecycle immutable ID, nor require the terminal body schema. Added both exact checks in Containers415dfae32a182391548c381c2349a476c3190310. Two pure signed-spool regressions now reject a conflicting signed container ID and a lifecycle-schema terminal body; all14 unit cases pass. Trusted operator signing already limits untrusted forgery, but conflicting trusted original records must still refuse rather than bypass allocation identity. No keys from an installed operator were read, and no workload was run for these regressions. Installed real Docker qualification remains independently blocked by exactcreate timeouts; the source identity correction does not explain that host behavior.
